title: When the Safehouse Falls
author: W. M. Whitlock
blurb: Beatrix Hartwell, a whistle-blower living under four names, has spent seven years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the summit convenes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
